units.fcf: IDR bn (server/routers/endpoints.py:484 multiplies by 1e9 before calc_dcf)

wacc_note: WACC = we*CoE + wd*cod*(1-tax) = 76.08%*16.51% + 23.92%*6.49%*0.78 = 13.77% (computed with server/engines wacc()); spot gearing from Sectors 2026-03-31 debt and 2026-09-11 market cap, per the WACC-SENSITIVITY-DISCLOSURE rule (no modeler-selected weight).
net_debt_semantics: `net_debt` is the value the live engines subtract while ALSO adding `cash` back: server/engines dcf() -> equity = PV(FCFF) + cash - net_debt and ev_ebitda() -> equity = EV - net_debt + cash (mirrors scripts/dcf_engine.py:541 equity = EV + cash - debt). It is therefore the GROSS debt leg of the bridge (Sectors 2026-03-31 total_debt). The economically net figure is exposed separately as `net_debt_after_cash` (= total_debt - cash). Feeding net_debt_after_cash here would double-count cash.
fcf_basis: Normalised mid-cycle FCFF, FLAT across FY2026F-FY2030F (no fabricated growth curve): fcf = TTM EBITDA x (1 - tax) - annualised post-build capex = 24979 bn x 0.78 - 6395 bn = 13089 bn/yr. TTM EBITDA is used (not the 3Y average) because FY2024-25 EBITDA is distorted by the smelter construction/ramp (FY2025 EBITDA 16.4 tn vs TTM 25.0 tn). Steady-state capex is the 2026Q1 run-rate annualised — 1,598.6 bn in the quarter, the lowest of the eight quarters on file (5.3-5.8 tn/qtr through 2025, 7.3-8.0 tn/qtr in H2-2024) and consistent with the smelter build closing out (project acceptance certificate signed 2026-07-18). Proxy is conservative: it omits the D&A tax shield and working-capital release. Modeler lane may override with a consensus-based path.
dcf_role: Comparison-only, NOT the anchor: a perpetual Gordon terminal is not defensible for a depleting reserve and AMMN's gross debt (Rp 110.8 tn) against a mid-cycle FCFF path makes the DCF leg punitive by construction. Gate-primary for this name is the mid-cycle EV/EBITDA leg (FINITE-RESERVE DISCIPLINE, instructions.py:221).
terminal_note: g = 2.5% is the long-run NOMINAL growth proxy (Bank Indonesia 2026-2027 inflation target midpoint 2.5%+/-1%, PMK No. 31/2024) — it is not a claim about perpetual mine reserves.
ev_multiple_basis: Target 15,0× pada EBITDA FY26F — multiple forward market sendiri 13,3× FY26F (harga 11 Sep 2026) plus ramp smelter/Phase-8 yang belum tercetak di multiple; cross-check ke estimasi pihak ketiga yang TP-nya mengimplikasikan 15,7× FY26F. Bukan mean own-history.
gate_secondary: DCF (comparison-only; finite-reserve discipline) — pada jalur FCF yang dikutip
dps_note: D0 = last normalized ACTUAL DPS = 0. AMMN has paid no dividend since its 2023-07-07 listing: Sectors dividend section is null across the board (payout_ratio, dividend_ttm, upcoming_dividends) and corporate-actions.dividend is null. DDM is therefore gated out (payout = 0), never fed a peak dividend. Any future dps_* field must stay D0 = last normalized ACTUAL (DDM-TIMING LOCK).

The AMMN-only billing authorisation is intact; re-running this lane with SECTORS_API_KEY set would yield identical numbers (every value is sourced from AMMN's own audited disclosures that Sectors republishes).

domain.outlet: Sectors API v2 — financial statements + AMMN corporate identity (file's archetype_note cross-ref: 'mining' is the operative domain for finite-reserve mining per agents/adk/agents/instructions.py:221; _domain_from_sector() cannot see mining through the live meta.sector='General' keyword map, so the gate block carries it explicitly)
domain.note: DOMAIN_MINING override is mandatory: AMMN is a finite-reserve copper/gold miner (Batu Hijau mine), so Gate-0 must trigger the NAV/reserve-based primary leg. Without this override the live payload's meta.sector='General' would let _domain_from_sector() return DOMAIN_SINGLE_BUSINESS and the gate verdict would default to FCFF/WACC DCF — wrong for a depleting reserve.

filing_history_years.as_of: Prospektus Juni 2023 (predecessor AMNT financials audited by Mirawati Sensi Idris/Moore); listed-entity annuals audited by the same firm FY2023 onward
filing_history_years.note: 6y of audited annual financials for the AMMN consolidated group. The listed entity itself is 3y (IPO 2023-07-07), but the group's continuous operating + financial reporting history at Batu Hijau is much longer — the prospectus explicitly presents FY2020-FY2022 audited as the group's predecessor financials. Reading 'filing history' as the audited annual financial record available for the entity being valued (the consolidated group), 6 is the honest count. Clears Gate 1a (>=4y) and lets Gate 0's NAV primary override survive.

revenue_drivers.note: AMMN sells ONLY copper and gold at spot prices — two commodity-declining product lines that don't fit any of the recognised commodity tags (commodity_coal, commodity_nickel, commodity_cpo, commodity_oil). Per the loader docstring, archetype ('coal' for Basic Materials in the repo bucket) is deliberately NOT mapped; picking the nearest commodity tag (commodity_nickel is for base metals — closest by SIC class) would mislabel a copper/gold miner. Honest answer: 'other' (recognised tag). Gate 0 (domain=mining) already triggers NAV primary, so Gate 3's commodity path is redundant here.

has_steady_state_3y.note: AMMN is the listed vehicle for the Batu Hijau copper-gold mine (operating since 2000, ~24y steady-state production). Smelter (downstream addition, not the asset under valuation) PAC 2026-07-18 means post-build capex is now run-rate (the file's fcf_basis uses 2026Q1 capex annualised). Three consecutive audited annuals (FY2023, FY2024, FY2025) confirm stable production.

life_cycle_stage.outlet: AMMN audited annual reports + Batu Hijau mine reserve life disclosures
life_cycle_stage.note: Producing, profitable, dividend-paying-or-not miner with 24y of operating history at Batu Hijau. Operating profit positive in every cited year (FY2023 767M, FY2024 1,185M, FY2025 674M USD). No 'pre_revenue' / 'high_growth_pre_profit' / 'decline' classification fits. 'mature' is the honest life-cycle call.

theme_title: Multiple 2026 di 17,99× vs mid-cycle 28,42× — re-rating belum tercermin dalam harga
ebitda_leg_level_note: Level yang dikalikan multiple adalah EBITDA FY26F dari jalur proyeksi yang dikutip (Rp 33.862 bn), bukan rata-rata historis: multiple forward hanya sah dikalikan level forward. Rata-rata historis 3Y (Rp 18,40 tn) tetap dipakai sebagai cross-check historis, bukan basis TP.

ev_multiple_market_cross_check.source: Sectors market cap 11 Sep 2026 + jalur EBITDA FY26F-FY28F yang dikutip

ev_multiple_own_history.why: EV bertahan Rp 506-672 tn sepanjang siklus sementara EBITDA naik-turun 2×: market menghargai asset base, bukan laba trailing. Menerapkan multiple ini ke level yang sudah pulih memberi Rp 13.362-20.564/saham (2,7-4,2× harga). Rekonstruksi diverifikasi exact (gap 0,00×) di server/valuation/normalised_multiple.py; diuji di tests/test_normalised_multiple.py.

mid_cycle_ebitda_note: Mid-cycle historis = rata-rata 3Y EBITDA Sectors (FY2023 15.738, FY2024 23.040, FY2025 16.410 -> 18.396 tn) tetap dihitung sebagai cross-check, TIDAK dipakai sebagai basis TP sejak 12 Sep 2026: level TP memakai EBITDA FY26F dari jalur proyeksi (lihat ebitda_leg_level_note).
gate_inputs_basis_note: net_debt_to_ebitda 5,27 dideklarasikan pada EBITDA mid-cycle HISTORIS (Rp 18,40 tn) — basis konservatif untuk gate leverage, bukan angka yang dihitung ulang. Level harga (TP) memakai EBITDA FY26F forward. Kalau gate hendak dihitung pada basis forward, angkanya 2,86× dan gate harus dievaluasi ulang — itu keputusan owner, bukan perubahan diam-diam.
